title: Agent: show a session-disposition ExternalPart (call link) as a link, never fetch it
description: mimi-content-10 §5.10: a conference join URL travels as an ExternalPart with disposition session. mimid parses Disposition::SESSION but the agent likely treats every ExternalPart as an attachment to fetch. Fix: never fetch a session part; show it as a 'join call' link on JMAP Chat and IRC; test with the §5.10 example.
close_reason: Fixed in 797b523 (branch session-part): session parts are never fetched; stored as calls; JMAP vtc MessageAction, IRC ACTION line; send via Store::send_call, JMAP actions, /msg mimid call. docs/design/agent-frontends.md §7.24.
